firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
The code and results behind our writeup "When Lower Loss Means a Worse Agent: The Hidden Decision in LLM Fine-Tuning" are now public:

https://github.com/bbalamdari/decision-point-audit

It contains the decision-point audit, which checks a fine-tuning label mask before training. It also has the probe scripts, the per-task results (counts only) and the paper as a PDF.
